```yaml
name: Brin PR Commit Security Scan

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  security_scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install Brin CLI
        run: npm install -g @brin/cli

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Run Brin scan on PR commits
        id: scan
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "Fetching commit list..."
          commits=$(git rev-list --reverse ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}..${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }})
          echo "Commits: $commits"
          summary="<!-- brin-security-scan -->\n\n# Brin Security Scan Summary\n\n| Commit | Status | Score | Findings |\n|--------|--------|-------|----------|"
          clean="true"
          for commit in $commits; do
            echo "Scanning commit $commit..."
            output=$(brin scan --commit "$commit" --output json 2>/dev/null || echo "{}")
            status=$(echo "$output" | jq -r '.status // "unknown"')
            score=$(echo "$output" | jq -r '.score // 0')
            findings=$(echo "$output" | jq -r '.findings[]? | .description' | paste -sd ', ' - || echo "none")
            if [[ "$status" == "dangerous" || $(echo "$score < 30" | bc -l) -eq 1 ]]; then
              clean="false"
            fi
            summary+="\n| $commit | $status | $score | $findings |"
          done
          echo "clean=$clean" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "summary<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$summary" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Comment PR with Brin results
        if: steps.scan.outputs.clean == 'false'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: ${{ steps.scan.outputs.summary }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          comment-tag: brin-security-scan
          mode: replace
          create-if-not-exists: true

      - name: Fail if security issues found
        if: steps.scan.outputs.clean == 'false'
        run: exit 1

      - name: Delete Brin comment if PR is clean
        if: steps.scan.outputs.clean == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const tag = 'brin-security-scan';
            const { data: comments } = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
            });
            const comment = comments.find(c => c.body.includes(`<!-- ${tag} -->`));
            if (comment) {
              await github.rest.issues.deleteComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                comment_id: comment.id,
              });
            }
```
